_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Rise of the Quartron#000.dst: 与 {p} 的 Nasea 交谈。

Rise of the Quartron#001.src: Shipment {~}A and {~}B, fully accounted for... shipments {~}C and {~}A...missing {~} of quartz content?!
Rise of the Quartron#001.dst: {~}A 和 {~}B 批货，全部清点无误……{~}C 和 {~}A 批货……石英少了 {~}？！
Rise of the Quartron#001.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#002.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, thy're getting bold...
Rise of the Quartron#002.dst: 啊，越来越糟了！从来没丢过这么多……不管是谁干的，胆子越来越大了……
Rise of the Quartron#002.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#003.src: Ugh, go AWAY! Quit hovering over my shoulder like that- wait, a Human? Since when did you get here?
Rise of the Quartron#003.dst: 呃，走开！别再那样在我肩膀后面晃来晃去——等等，人类？你什么时候来的？
Rise of the Quartron#003.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#004.src: What, you like listening to the melodious sound of my voice or something? Or do you intend to help out?
Rise of the Quartron#004.dst: 怎么，你喜欢听我悦耳的声音还是怎样？还是你打算帮忙？
Rise of the Quartron#004.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#005.src: Well, I'm flattered either way, and I could certainly use the help. Quartz is going missing from my shipments.
Rise of the Quartron#005.dst: 嗯，不管是哪个我都很荣幸，而且我确实需要帮手。我的货里的石英一直在不见。
Rise of the Quartron#005.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#006.src: Obviously one of the laborers is siphoning it to someplace, and I can't have that happening. So, be a private eye, humie.
Rise of the Quartron#006.dst: 显然是有哪个工人把它偷偷运到了某个地方，我可不能放任这种事。所以，去当个私家侦探吧，人类小家伙。
Rise of the Quartron#006.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#007.src: This is actually pretty dire- quartz has some magicality to it, see. It likes to soak up magic power, which means it can be weaponized.
Rise of the Quartron#007.dst: 这其实挺严重的——你看，石英带有一些魔法特性。它喜欢吸收魔法能量，这就代表它可以被做成武器。
Rise of the Quartron#007.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#008.src: We tend not to use it for weapons since it can overcharge, but that's neither here nor there, is it?
Rise of the Quartron#008.dst: 我们一般不拿它做武器，因为它可能会过载，不过这不是重点，对吧？
Rise of the Quartron#008.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#009.src: Every siphoned shipment has gone through Dado. Interrogate him! He hangs out past the big red tent, near the house with red flags.
Rise of the Quartron#009.dst: 每一批被偷的货都经过 Dado 的手。去审问他！他常在大红帐篷后面，挂着红旗的房子附近。
Rise of the Quartron#009.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#010.src: Talk to Dado and see if he is the culprit.
Rise of the Quartron#010.dst: 与 Dado 交谈，看看他是不是犯人。

Rise of the Quartron#011.src: Okay, these go to division P, and...look, I'm busy allocating these deliveries to {p}. Go pester someone else, okay?
Rise of the Quartron#011.dst: 好，这些送去 P 区，还有……听着，我正忙着分配这些要送去 {p} 的货。去烦别人吧，好吗？
Rise of the Quartron#011.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#012.src: ...what. You...think I... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, that's RICH coming from a human of all things!
Rise of the Quartron#012.dst: ……什么。你……以为我……噗……噗哈哈哈！噢，这话从人类嘴里说出来可真好笑！
Rise of the Quartron#012.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#013.src: "Oh, me, the hired gun species that kills for money, will accuse you, a storied worker of seven years, of illegal activity!" Wow, you HYPOCRITE!
Rise of the Quartron#013.dst: “噢，我，一个拿钱杀人的雇佣兵种族，要指控你，一个干了七年的老员工，从事非法活动！”哇，你这个伪君子！
Rise of the Quartron#013.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#014.src: I'm hardly even angry about this! But, yeah, you freak. You got the wrong guy, surprise! Your brain workin' right in there?
Rise of the Quartron#014.dst: 我根本懒得生气！不过，是啊，你这个怪胎。你找错人了，惊喜吧！你脑子没问题吧？
Rise of the Quartron#014.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#015.src: I bet you got some wires crossed in there, huh? Go scuttle on back to town and kill someone's Wybel for pocket change or something.
Rise of the Quartron#015.dst: 我打赌你脑子里有线接错了吧？滚回镇上去，随便杀几只别人家的 Wybel 赚点零花钱吧。
Rise of the Quartron#015.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#016.src: Go back to Nasea and tell her about Dado’s response.
Rise of the Quartron#016.dst: 回去找 Nasea，告诉她 Dado 的反应。

Rise of the Quartron#017.src: I'm just going to take a wild guess and say that asking him nicely whether he committed theft didn't bring up any answers.
Rise of the Quartron#017.dst: 我就大胆猜一下：好声好气地问他有没有偷东西，什么答案都没问出来吧。
Rise of the Quartron#017.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#018.src: What, he brushed you off like THAT? Jeez, I knew he was a jerk, but really? That's just uncalled for.
Rise of the Quartron#018.dst: 什么，他就这样把你打发走了？天啊，我知道他是个混蛋，但真的这样？这也太过分了。
Rise of the Quartron#018.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#019.src: We have to make him talk...if shipments keep going missing, my contractors are going to look elsewhere!
Rise of the Quartron#019.dst: 我们得让他开口……如果货再不见，我的客户就要去找别家了！
Rise of the Quartron#019.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#020.src: We need to prove that he's guilty...wait, you came to ME for ideas? This is why I asked you for help! Am I really back to square one?
Rise of the Quartron#020.dst: 我们得证明他有罪……等等，你是来找我出主意的？我就是为了这个才找你帮忙的！我真的又回到原点了？
Rise of the Quartron#020.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#022.src: I...what are you doing here, uh...Larry? Were you missing quartz too??
Rise of the Quartron#022.dst: 我……你来这里干嘛，呃……Larry？你也丢了石英吗？？
Rise of the Quartron#022.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#023.src: Ah, it's...Lari. No, the quartz shipment found its way fine...
Rise of the Quartron#023.dst: 啊，是……Lari。不，石英那批货顺利送到了……
Rise of the Quartron#023.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#024.src: But, there was hardly an effect. Your idea was, unfortunately, a dead end.
Rise of the Quartron#024.dst: 可是，几乎没有效果。很遗憾，你的主意行不通。
Rise of the Quartron#024.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#025.src: Well, I did warn you that it was only an idea. I manage the mine, I don't practice purification magic. Don't pin anything on me for that.
Rise of the Quartron#025.dst: 嗯，我早就提醒过你，那只是个主意。我是管矿场的，又不会净化魔法。这事可别算到我头上。
Rise of the Quartron#025.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#026.src: I did not intend to imply that. Your help was appreciated, fate simply had opposing plans...
Rise of the Quartron#026.dst: 我并没有这个意思。很感谢你的帮忙，只是命运另有安排……
Rise of the Quartron#026.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#027.src: ...is this human a part of your operations, miss?
Rise of the Quartron#027.dst: ……这个人类是你们工作的一分子吗，小姐？
Rise of the Quartron#027.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#028.src: Well, in a sense. Someone's siphoning quartz, but our suspect wasn't intimidated by the ten tons of armor, so we're at a loss. Any ideas?
Rise of the Quartron#028.dst: 嗯，算是吧。有人在偷运石英，可是我们的嫌犯被这十吨重的盔甲吓唬也不为所动，我们没辙了。你有什么主意吗？
Rise of the Quartron#028.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#029.src: ...as a matter of fact, I do have a solution. Elven botany describes a flower that grows decently close by, the "Tattytale" flower.
Rise of the Quartron#029.dst: ……说实在的，我确实有个办法。精灵植物学里记载了一种就长在这附近的花，叫“告密花”。
Rise of the Quartron#029.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#030.src: It weakens the will of those who catch a whiff of its petals, making them pliable to questions. It's...unpleasant, but if it is needed, I suppose.
Rise of the Quartron#030.dst: 闻到它花瓣气味的人意志会变弱，问什么都会乖乖回答。这……不太光彩，不过既然有需要，我想也只能这样。
Rise of the Quartron#030.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#031.src: There is a cave infested with spiders, and covered with webs in the western mountain. It is the only place it grows outside of {p}, unfortunately.
Rise of the Quartron#031.dst: 西边山里有个到处是蜘蛛、布满蛛网的洞穴。很遗憾，除了 {p} 以外，那是唯一长着这种花的地方。
Rise of the Quartron#031.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#032.src: Nasea, since it didn't help, I've returned the quartz. I thank you for your help...and I shall bid you both adieu.
Rise of the Quartron#032.dst: Nasea，既然没有帮助，我把石英还回来了。谢谢你的帮忙……那我就向两位告辞了。
Rise of the Quartron#032.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#034.src: Make Dado confess by using the Tattytale Flower.
Rise of the Quartron#034.dst: 用告密花让 Dado 招供。

Rise of the Quartron#035.src: Hey, everyone's least-favorite attack dog! Here boy! You want the emerald? Go kill all the flies in my house! Come on boy!
Rise of the Quartron#035.dst: 嘿，这不是大家最讨厌的走狗嘛！过来，乖狗狗！想要绿宝石吗？去把我家里的苍蝇全杀光！来啊，乖狗狗！
Rise of the Quartron#035.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#036.src: Aw, flowers. How sweet of you! Sorry, but I don't cave to psychopaths or flattery, hehehee!
Rise of the Quartron#036.dst: 哇，花耶。你真贴心！可惜啊，我不吃疯子那一套，也不吃奉承，嘿嘿嘿！
Rise of the Quartron#036.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#037.src: I...huff... What was THAT for?! Are you offended that I don't like your flo- What? What am I doing with the quartz?
Rise of the Quartron#037.dst: 我……呼……那是干嘛？！你是因为我不喜欢你的花所以生气了——什么？我拿石英干什么？
Rise of the Quartron#037.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#038.src: Uh, isn't it obvious? I'm working overtime and sending it up to Popo, duh. Where else would I be sending it?
Rise of the Quartron#038.dst: 呃，这不是很明显吗？我加班把它送上去给 Popo 啊。不然我还能送去哪？
Rise of the Quartron#038.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#039.src: What- Where's Popo sending it? Um...no clue. Whoever it is, they're super rich though. They pay me more than my house is worth every shipment!
Rise of the Quartron#039.dst: 什么——Popo 把它送去哪？嗯……不知道。不管是谁，那人超有钱就对了。每批货他们付我的钱都比我的房子还值钱！
Rise of the Quartron#039.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#040.src: Not sure why you need to- What? Where's Popo? Uh, he said he'd meet me at the cart track overpass, near the teal flags.
Rise of the Quartron#040.dst: 不知道你为什么要——什么？Popo 在哪？呃，他说会在矿车轨道的高架桥那里等我，靠近青绿色旗子的地方。
Rise of the Quartron#040.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#041.src: This was going to be our first meeting, so I don't know what he looks like, and likewise he's never seen me.
Rise of the Quartron#041.dst: 这本来是我们第一次见面，所以我不知道他长什么样，他也从没见过我。
Rise of the Quartron#041.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#042.src: ...uh. Okay, I haave no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...
Rise of the Quartron#042.dst: ……呃。好吧，我完全不知道为什么要把这些全告诉你……嗯，不过你还有那种花吗？其实感觉挺棒的……
Rise of the Quartron#042.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#043.src: Go up the minecart hill and find Popo.
Rise of the Quartron#043.dst: 登上矿车山坡，找到 Popo。

Rise of the Quartron#044.src: Ah, you must- Wait, never mind. I was expecting a visit from someone else.
Rise of the Quartron#044.dst: 啊，你一定就是——等等，算了。我在等别人。
Rise of the Quartron#044.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#045.src: Wait, you're Dado? I guess humans have more brain capacity than orcs after all, hehah!
Rise of the Quartron#045.dst: 等等，你就是 Dado？看来人类的脑容量终究比兽人大嘛，嘿哈！
Rise of the Quartron#045.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#046.src: Okay, down to business. I'm gonna look busy to cover for you while you get to the base for briefing. You'll get the details there.
Rise of the Quartron#046.dst: 好，说正事。我会装作很忙帮你打掩护，你先去基地听简报。细节到那里就知道了。
Rise of the Quartron#046.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#047.src: You stick out like a sore thumb, but thankfully humans like to get into lots of weird spots, so it won't look too out of place.
Rise of the Quartron#047.dst: 你太显眼了，不过幸好人类就爱钻进各种奇怪的地方，所以看起来不会太突兀。
Rise of the Quartron#047.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#048.src: Use the small rail here, flick the lever. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.
Rise of the Quartron#048.dst: 用这里的小轨道，扳一下拉杆。这样看起来你就只是……在做人类会做的事，不会惹人怀疑。
Rise of the Quartron#048.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#049.src: Ride the minecart to the bandit mansion.
Rise of the Quartron#049.dst: 搭乘矿车前往强盗豪宅。

Rise of the Quartron#050.src: Hop on the minecart, it's leaving! But act natural!
Rise of the Quartron#050.dst: 快上矿车，要开了！但要表现得自然点！
Rise of the Quartron#050.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#051.src: Interesting, a human's been swept up in our plans. Hadn't expected the work force to diversify so fast.
Rise of the Quartron#051.dst: 有意思，一个人类被卷进了我们的计划。没想到劳动力这么快就多元化了。
Rise of the Quartron#051.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#052.src: Time for the rundown, oh I love explaining this! I think you'll find what I have to say quite interesting, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#052.dst: 该来说明一下了，噢，我最爱解释这个了！我想你会觉得我要说的相当有趣，没错没错！
Rise of the Quartron#052.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#053.src: You see, quartz is a powerful magical material- moreso than many know! It can absorb and harness magical energy, but what more? I had to find out!
Rise of the Quartron#053.dst: 你看，石英是一种强大的魔法材料——比很多人以为的更强！它能吸收并驾驭魔法能量，但还能做到什么？我非弄清楚不可！
Rise of the Quartron#053.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#054.src: The rubes in my research department got me kicked out for suggesting we further our research. What kind of scientist is scared to make advancements?!
Rise of the Quartron#054.dst: 我研究部门里那些乡巴佬，因为我提议进一步研究就把我踢了出去。哪有科学家会害怕进步的？！
Rise of the Quartron#054.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#055.src: But without a board of directors breathing down my neck, my research has led me exactly where I'd hoped, and even more, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#055.dst: 不过少了董事会在我背后盯着，我的研究正好走到了我期望的地方，甚至更远，没错没错！
Rise of the Quartron#055.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#056.src: Oi. Got a guest taking the secret passage.
Rise of the Quartron#056.dst: 喂。有客人走了秘密通道。
Rise of the Quartron#056.speaker: Guard

Rise of the Quartron#058.src: Harnort! I'M Dado! This sicko mugged me for info! They're gonna ruin us both!
Rise of the Quartron#058.dst: Harnort！我才是 Dado！这个变态抢了我的情报！他们会把我们俩都毁了！
Rise of the Quartron#058.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#059.src: Guards!! GUARDS!! Capture them! Stop them! Tie them up, do something!! Our research can't go to waste, not at this vital point!!
Rise of the Quartron#059.dst: 守卫！！守卫！！抓住他们！拦住他们！把他们绑起来，想想办法！！我们的研究不能白费，尤其是在这个关键时刻！！
Rise of the Quartron#059.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#060.src: HA! That's what you get for showing me that amazi- HORRIBLE flower! Outta here!
Rise of the Quartron#060.dst: 哈！谁叫你给我看那朵超棒——超可怕的花！我走啦！
Rise of the Quartron#060.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#061.src: Break into the laboratory and stop Harnort.

Rise of the Quartron#062.src: ...so, it's come to this then. I knew the names of all those guards. I didn't hurt anyone to meet my goal.
Rise of the Quartron#062.dst: ……所以，终究还是走到这一步了。那些守卫每个人的名字我都知道。我从没为了达成目标伤害任何人。
Rise of the Quartron#062.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#063.src: You...I won't let their sacrifices be in vain! {p} needs to see what quartz is truly capable of! I MUST show them.
Rise of the Quartron#063.dst: 你……我不会让他们的牺牲白费！{p} 必须见识石英真正的能耐！我必须让他们看到。
Rise of the Quartron#063.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#064.src: My Quartrons are the future! They need to see it! It will have been worth the scheming, and the thieving, and the burnt bridges!
Rise of the Quartron#064.dst: 我的 Quartron 就是未来！他们必须见识到！到时候，那些算计、那些偷窃、那些断掉的后路，全都会值得！
Rise of the Quartron#064.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#065.src: But you- you couldn't leave well enough alone. You stepped in, and callously threw away a hundred lives to stop the inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#065.dst: 但你——你就是不肯罢手。你插了手，冷酷地牺牲了一百条性命，只为了阻止无法避免的未来！
Rise of the Quartron#065.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#066.src: One live for a hundred is a fair trade!!
Rise of the Quartron#066.dst: 一条命换一百条命，是公平的交易！！
Rise of the Quartron#066.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#067.src: Take down the Quartron and return to nasea with the news.
Rise of the Quartron#067.dst: 打倒 Quartron，把消息带回给 Nasea。

Rise of the Quartron#068.src: Aaah! Not responding?! You- You... YOU! You've destroyed the future! MY future! GAVEL'S future!!!
Rise of the Quartron#068.dst: 啊啊！没反应了？！你——你……你！你毁了未来！我的未来！Gavel 的未来！！！
Rise of the Quartron#068.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#069.src: The futures of a hundred men or more!! You humans deserve to burn in hell for your careless destruction!
Rise of the Quartron#069.dst: 一百个人甚至更多人的未来！！你们人类就该为你们草率的破坏在地狱里被烧死！
Rise of the Quartron#069.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#070.src: The energy output by the detonations is overcharging the quartz in the walls... This entire lab is a deathtrap now! Do us all a favor- SIT STILL AND DIE ALREADY!!
Rise of the Quartron#070.dst: 爆炸释放的能量正让墙里的石英过载……整个实验室现在就是个死亡陷阱！帮大家一个忙——乖乖站着去死吧！！
Rise of the Quartron#070.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#071.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.
Rise of the Quartron#071.dst: ……你可得好好解释一下了。先是你跑去找那个告状花还是什么的，就不见了。
Rise of the Quartron#071.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#072.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or nugged, and ran off to the east ridge.
Rise of the Quartron#072.dst: 然后 Dado 尖叫着跑过这里，说他被下药还是下什么的，接着就往东边山脊跑了。
Rise of the Quartron#072.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#073.src: Then, he came back, asking me if I'd found any more of those flowers, and while he was blabbering the ENTIRE MOUNTAIN SHOOK.
Rise of the Quartron#073.dst: 然后，他又跑回来问我有没有找到更多那种花，结果他在那里唠叨的时候，整座山都在晃。
Rise of the Quartron#073.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#074.src: So, spill it. I wanted you to figure out where my quartz was going, and you made one of my workers an addict and caused a freaking landslide!!
Rise of the Quartron#074.dst: 所以，说吧。我是要你查出我的石英去了哪里，结果你让我一个工人上了瘾，还引发了该死的山崩！！
Rise of the Quartron#074.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#075.src: ...uh huh. Mhm. ... ...yeah, go on. Uh, okay, I can buy that... I'd never believe you if you hadn't given me the proof.
Rise of the Quartron#075.dst: ……嗯哼。嗯。……嗯，继续说。呃，好吧，这我能接受……要不是你给我看了证据，我绝对不会信你。
Rise of the Quartron#075.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#076.src: A militarized quartz mech...yeesh. That guy sounds like a piece of work. Guess that wasn't really your fault after all.
Rise of the Quartron#076.dst: 军事化的石英机甲……天啊。那家伙听起来真不是个好东西。看来这终究不是你的错。
Rise of the Quartron#076.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#077.src: I'll round up the police to get all those guards and them. ...what's with that look? Almost looks like you don't think anyone'll be there. Anyways...
Rise of the Quartron#077.dst: 我会叫警察去把那些守卫和他们都抓起来。……那是什么表情？看起来好像你觉得那里一个人都不剩了。总之……
Rise of the Quartron#077.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#078.src: Okay, so I'll out you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do justt one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.
Rise of the Quartron#078.dst: 好，那我跟你做个简单的交易。你查出了这件事，我现在就付你钱，如果你再帮我做一件事，就会有额外的好处。
Rise of the Quartron#078.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#079.src: Take the elevator past the yellow flags and go into the private site, you have my permission. I'll meet you up there.
Rise of the Quartron#079.dst: 搭升降梯经过黄旗，进入私人区域，我准许你进去。我们在上面见。
Rise of the Quartron#079.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#080.src: Join Nasea at the end of the minecart track.
Rise of the Quartron#080.dst: 在矿车轨道尽头与 Nasea 会合。

Rise of the Quartron#082.src: This is the newest mining annex, but we've hit a bit of a brick wall. Well...a gravel wall.
Rise of the Quartron#082.dst: 这是最新的采矿区，不过我们碰壁了。嗯……应该说是碰上砾石墙了。
Rise of the Quartron#082.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#083.src: So, if you can open up this area, you'll get access to the mine and whatever you find in it.
Rise of the Quartron#083.dst: 所以，如果你能打通这一区，你就能进入矿坑，里面找到的东西也都归你。
Rise of the Quartron#083.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#084.src: I have to be off though, lots of work to get to. Hm. It looks like the core you showed me folded up into a ring. Really high-tech stuff, but I can't use it, so you can take it.
Rise of the Quartron#084.dst: 不过我得走了，还有很多工作要做。嗯。你给我看的那个核心好像折成了一枚戒指。真是高科技的玩意，但我用不上，所以你拿去吧。
Rise of the Quartron#084.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#085.src: Suppose that's all, then! Here's your payment. I'll see you around.
Rise of the Quartron#085.dst: 那就这样吧！这是你的报酬。回头见。
Rise of the Quartron#085.speaker: Nasea
